Proactively using AI for efficiency, speed, and quality. Agents such as: Claude Code, Cursor/xAI, Codex, etc.</p> </li> <li> <p>Judgment to manually review AI output and full accountability for all AI-generated code.</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Benefits</strong></h3> <p>You get to lead Elvoro’s proprietary AI marketing engine and shape its technical and creative direction alongside the founder.
